name: client-quotes
purpose: The client-stories band: a framed `quote-tabs` carousel of customer quotes, each signed by its author and marked by the client's logo, with one call to action under it. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'client-quotes', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `registration-frame`, `quote-tabs` and `button`.
useWhen: Rendering page JSON, or you need a whole band with no custom content → the section (`client-quotes`). Building an SFC by hand, needing slots, or nesting inside another band → the primitive (`quote-tabs`).
Use ClientQuotes for a band of customer quotes the reader browses by client.
To let several customers speak in turn, one at a time, near the end of a page's argument.
avoidWhen: For one quote beside a logo wall → use `logo-wall-section`.
For a scrolling strip of analyst recognitions → use `recognition-marquee`.
related: `quote-tabs` — the tabbed quote carousel this band frames.
bestPractices: Three to six items; the tabs need room for each client's mark.
Give each item either a registry `mark` or a `logo` URL with `clientName`, not both.

On azion.com the client wall is in each brand's colours, not one ink: give each client its logo file from the package, `import gpa from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/gpa-extended-color.svg'`, then `logo: gpa`. On the dark site use `-extended-color.svg` where the colour logo reads on black (GPA, Zoop, HeroSpark, Magalu) and `-extended-reversed.svg` where the colour logo has dark lettering (Axur, Contabilizei, Dafiti, Global Fashion Group as `gfg`); on a light page use `-extended-color.svg`. A registry `mark` (one ink, follows the theme) is for a client that ships no logo file. `catalog.json` lists every file under `imports` with `"kind": "asset"`.

Every item needs its quotation (`text`): a card is a tab that features it, and an item without one is skipped. Do not invent a quotation to fill the wall; list the clients you have quotes for, or use `logo-wall-section` for one quotation beside a logo wall.

The band advances on a timer like azion.com's. Set `:autoplay="false"` when the page must hold one quote (a still capture, a page with other moving content), and bind `v-model` (the selected index) to open on a quote other than the first; never wrap or re-time the band yourself.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a hash link can target it.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the quote carousel.

props.name: items
props.doc: The quotes, in order; each is `{ text, name?, jobTitle?, mark?, logo?, clientName?, photo? }` where `mark` is a registry mark name and `logo` a mark URL named by `clientName`.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: Button under the quotes; `{ label, href, trailing? }`. Omitted when absent.

props.name: autoplay
props.doc: Advances to the next quote on a timer, as `quote-tabs` does, with its visible pause control; pauses under the pointer or keyboard focus and never runs under reduced motion.

props.name: autoplayInterval
props.doc: Milliseconds each quote is held before the band advances.
